suppress.notes: CVE-2026-33117 is in the Azure Key Vault Keys library (azure-security-keyvault-keys before 4.10.6): a broken authentication-tag check in its local cryptography path. It is listed under the generic "Azure SDK for Java" CPE with versionEndExcluding 4.10.6, so every other Azure SDK jar with a lower version number matches, although none of them contains that code. We do not depend on Key Vault Keys (not in the dependency tree). The package pattern excludes it on purpose, so the CVE still alerts if it is ever added.

CVE-2026-53914 is unsafe deserialization in the build cache metadata of JetBrains Kotlin before 2.4.20, i.e. in the compiler and build tooling. We only ship the Kotlin standard library at runtime (kotlin-stdlib*, a transitive dependency of okhttp via the Microsoft Graph SDK) and compile no Kotlin, so the vulnerable code never runs. Expires 2027-03-27 to force a recheck; the match also disappears once okhttp/Graph pull in Kotlin 2.4.20 or later.

CVE-2022-31691 is in the Spring Tools IDE extensions for Eclipse and VS Code (Spring Boot Tools, Concourse, Bosh, Cloud Foundry manifest editors), which use SnakeYAML for YAML editing. It matches spring-boot-devtools through the "Spring Boot Tools" CPE, but devtools is a different product: a local development dependency (optional, runtime scope) that Spring Boot also leaves out of the packaged application jar.
